evidence.reason: Systemd defines `%i` as the escaped instance name and `%I` as the unescaped instance name. Line 177 substitutes the same raw instance for both, so for a unit such as `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `Service=%I.service` should expand to `crq-tick.service`, but the scan instead produces `crq\x2dtick.service` and misses the target. The smallest compatible fix is to unescape only the `%I` replacement, leaving `%i` unchanged.
